plan.title: Cart is not emptied after checkout when a new item is added
plan.description: After checking out a cart containing one keyboard, the cart appears empty. Adding a wireless mouse afterwards should leave the cart with only that one new item.
preconditions: buggy-shop is running at the target URL
Every execution starts from a fresh browser context, hence a new session with an empty cart
Checkout completes without requiring extra input (no form or confirmation dialog beyond the Checkout button)

steps.description: The cart badge starts at Cart (0)
The cart holds one keyboard before checkout
The cart badge is back to Cart (0) after checkout
The cart shows the newly added wireless mouse
After checkout, adding one mouse leaves exactly one item in the cart, so the badge shows Cart (1)

metadata.symptom: I bought a keyboard and then kept shopping. When I added a mouse, the keyboard I had already paid for appeared in my cart again.
